content.label: 1. Prepare
content: Enable custom calibration and release all keys.

content.label: 2. Measure
content: Press Start, then fully press the keys you want to calibrate.

content.label: 3. Save
content: Press Finish. Disable custom calibration to use defaults.

content.label: Live updates
content: Use HID Console for live progress.

content.label: Hysteresis
content: Classic mode: release travel below the actuation point.

content.label: With Rapid Trigger
content: Use RT release sensitivity instead of hysteresis.

content.label: Rapid Trigger
content: After the actuation point, release and re-press follow key movement without returning to the top.

content.label: Press sensitivity
content: Downward travel required to re-press after release.

content.label: Release sensitivity
content: Upward travel from the deepest point required to release.

content.label: Top dead zone
content: Returning here releases the key and disarms Rapid Trigger.

content.label: Description
content: Powers down sensors, matrix scan, and LEDs when disconnected from USB host.
